REST/JSON interface exposed by the Cerbos Policy Decision Point (PDP) for
authorization decisions and policy administration. Includes CheckResources,
PlanResources, ServerInfo, OpenID AuthZEN endpoints, and the Admin API for
policy and schema management. Generated as a best-effort spec from public
Cerbos documentation; the canonical OpenAPI is served by every PDP at
/schema/swagger.json.
